    14→## User Story
    15→As a **Finkargo employee or client**

    20→Currently, the Finkargo Automation Hub only supports a light theme with a white/light gray background. Users who work extended hours, prefer dark interfaces, or work in low-light environments experience eye strain and fatigue.
